scope: Development authoring pilot after density-field and bounded-route changes; prepared admitted catalog, same author/reviewer and shared context. Three fresh briefs, not an independent holdout or matched quality comparison.

cases.brief: Make a rural traveler's waystation on the edge of a broad meadow. A barn, market and well should form a compact welcoming court beside the main trail, with a shady picnic clearing farther along a returning woodland loop. Keep the meadow open. Layer trees, shrubs, rocks and groundcover into irregular stands with soft transitions; do not fill the landscape uniformly. Use catalog buildings only.
checks: Barn, market and well define a welcoming court
Court and shaded picnic clearing are connected by a walking loop
Woodland and groundcover have irregular, gradual edges
Path, buildings and props have convincing contact and clear circulation

cases.brief: Make a wooded ridge sanctuary with no buildings. A canvas camp sits in a sheltered low clearing, while a stone arch and rock outcrop form a recognizable destination about five meters higher. A winding ascent and separate return form a loop. Mix birch and conifers in uneven stands, with ferns and flowers thinning into clearings, and frame the arch from the approach.
checks: A sheltered canvas camp anchors the lower clearing
Arch and rock outcrop occupy a distinctly higher destination
A continuous ascent and return form a traversable loop
Mixed woodland and groundcover transition naturally into clearings
The approach reveals the arch and all major placements look grounded

cases.brief: Make a two-level orchard farm. Place the house and a shaded garden on a lower terrace, with a barn and wind pump on a working terrace about six meters higher. Between them place orderly fruit trees with a clearly open entrance. Connect the two yards with a gently winding approach and woodland return, avoiding shallow overlapping forks. Frame an open meadow with layered irregular woods. Use catalog buildings only.
checks: House garden and upper working yard occupy distinct levels
Orderly fruit trees have a clear entrance
Ascent and return connect both yards without overlapping path gaps
Layered woodland frames open meadow with gradual transitions
Buildings, orchard and garden details feel coherent and grounded
